program: APP-SYN-01 — Bounded App-Asset / Whole-App Packet Synthesis 01

drive_stage_input.file_name: Kymaean Core Stage Background Successor 01 — Frozen.png
drive_stage_input.residency: Drive remains visual-master authority; runtime copy is disposable authenticated input and is not committed to GitHub.

hash_basis: Repository text SHA-256 is canonical LF UTF-8; Stage SHA-256 is raw PNG bytes.

review_surface.wide_layout: 1200px viewport; two columns; each synthetic surface max-width 420px; no transform scaling
review_surface.compact_layout: 320px viewport; one column; surface width 100%; no content reorder
review_surface.stage_treatment: Exact 1672x941 raster embedded by verified data URI; width scales to container with height auto; no crop, overlay, filter, recolor, retouch or transform.

synthetic_content.heading: Primary information remains clear.
synthetic_content.body: Supporting text explains the situation without changing the hierarchy.

clr_contextual_probes.role_mapping: Outer review page remains CMP neutral page. Family field colors only the synthetic carrier; primary/secondary/boundary/soft-surface retain CLR role meanings. Accent is restricted to a small non-semantic strip and replay-control border and never becomes selected/success/active semantics.

failure_thresholds: Stage runtime input must match exact raw SHA-256, byte size and 1672x941 intrinsic dimensions.
Exactly 11 synthetic surfaces must materialize in every browser mode.
No required element may horizontally overflow the viewport or its carrier by more than 1 CSS px.
Every surface carries exactly one accessible Kymaean name and exact C0 geometry; O3 visibility changes only in preregistered NO_O3/reference cases.
Sequential Tab focus must reach state controls on every surface with >=2px non-none :focus-visible outline; selected witness remains >=3px independently.
At 1200 and 320, baseline/200%-resize/text-spacing/forced-colors modes preserve required content and DOM order.
Normal F1A computes 460ms duration and 70ms second-peer delay; normal CS2 computes 280ms opacity transition. Reduced-motion computes zero transition for both.
No remote resource references, custom fonts, canvas/WebGL, gradients, filters, backdrop filters, glow, autoplay or looping motion.
Forced-colors evidence applies only to the HTML synthesis carrier; the exact baked Stage raster is never relabeled as native high-contrast validation.

director_review_surface.primary_aesthetic: normal-wide screenshot/contact sheet from the frozen carrier after mechanical PASS
director_review_surface.law: Design Sol freezes whole-system view before Director preference. If both CLR F2/F1 remain materially valid, Director choice is contextual and does not create final-palette authority.

explicit_non_authority: No Stage pixel or geometry mutation.
No CLR F3/F4 rerun, new CLR family, fixture retune after exposure, or automatic F2/F1 winner.
No final palette, typeface, material, motion, symbol, wordmark, identity or production tokens.
No Phase-C exit or implementation/WinUI/native accessibility claim.
No resolution of ODR-05/07/14/15/19/30 and no semantics for Observed Cues, pips or inter-Character arcs.
freeze_law: Manifest 04 supersedes Manifest 03 only for deterministic review-label reflow repair after a mechanical matrix failure and before subjective review. The repair is limited to unscored probe-label wrapping. No design value, CLR mapping, Stage input, topology, browser mode, threshold, criterion or scoring law may be retuned.

browser_launcher_repair.finding: Microsoft Edge launcher exited after spawning a healthy isolated headless child. --remote-debugging-port=0 did not publish DevToolsActivePort to the requested disposable profile, so the frozen probe stopped before navigating to APP-SYN-01.
browser_launcher_repair.repair: Use fixed isolated CDP port 9229 by default, poll /json/version rather than DevToolsActivePort, and issue Browser.close after diagnostics so the detached headless child terminates cleanly.

browser_transport.profile_isolation: one disposable user-data-dir per browser mode

browser_measurement_repair.finding: The repaired launcher produced a valid normal-wide diagnostic. All 11 reported overflow records were the intentional 1x1 clipped .brand-name accessibility spans; all 11 carrier scroll widths equaled client widths and all 11 surfaces passed keyboard-focus observation.
browser_measurement_repair.repair: Keep raw overflow diagnostics unchanged. Browser verifier excludes only SPAN.brand-name records whose rendered width is <=1.1px and clientWidth <=1px from material-overflow classification, requires exactly 11 such records per mode, and still fails any other overflow.

invalid_matrix_evidence: resize200-wide: APP_COMPACT_IDENTITY_STACK probe label overflow only
resize200-320: three reference probe labels plus parent article scroll widths caused solely by those labels
browser_carrier_repair.finding: Long underscore-separated review-only probe labels could not wrap under the frozen 200% resize stress. Synthesis F2/F1 surfaces, Stage raster, application content, state controls, identity geometry and motion content did not produce material overflow.
browser_carrier_repair.repair: Add min-width:0; overflow-wrap:anywhere; word-break:normal; hyphens:none to .probe-label only. Label text, identifiers, DOM order, semantics, scored content and all synthesis values remain unchanged.
